courses.subject: OCSC
courses.title: Conceptual Introduction to Occupational Science
courses.description: Deconstruction of the original precepts of occupational science while examining several works from other disciplines. Study of early and recent trends and critiques of occupational science to develop an assessment of the state of the discipline and future directions.

courses.subject: OCSC
courses.title: Theorizing on Human Doing
courses.description: A reading and discussion of major theories of action from various disciplines. Works read will also entail associated issues such as identity, place, culture, and social relations.

courses.subject: OCSC
courses.title: Seminar on Special Topics in Occupational Science
courses.description: Discussion and critical evaluation of philosophy, theory, and scientific issues associated with the study of people's activities in the context of their everyday lives. Topics differ each semester.

courses.subject: OCSC
courses.title: Independent Study in Occupational Science
courses.description: Independent study to pursue specific interests and topics under faculty supervision.
